description: This file is a JavaScript test script for the Thunder Plugin OCIContainer, which performs various container management operations via WebSocket RPC calls, including starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and querying container status, as well as registering and unregistering event listeners.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a timestamp relative to startTime.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the RPC server.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket and waits for the response, with optional response checking and timeout.

methods.name: waitEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event message from the WebSocket, with optional timeout and response validation.
